browser_note: Screenshot capture in this Chrome window is non-functional (viewport reports 0x0, CDP clip error). All findings below are DOM and CSSOM receipts read live, plus deterministic renders built from the actual image files.

cls.why: the block emits width=1448 height=1086 attributes and an inline aspect-ratio, so the box is reserved before the image loads

mobile_and_responsive.method: scanned all 49 stylesheets including every @media block for any rule matching the featured image or its figure that sets object-fit, aspect-ratio, width, height or max-height
mobile_and_responsive.verdict: the 4/3 + contain behaviour is viewport independent; mobile, tablet and desktop render the identical ratio, so the full plate is visible at every width
mobile_and_responsive.overflow: contain can never overflow its box by definition, and the img is width:100% inside a constrained group; no horizontal overflow is introduced
mobile_and_responsive.distortion: none; contain preserves the intrinsic ratio, and for the plates box ratio == image ratio so the image is pixel-for-pixel undistorted

grid_uniformity: every card in the query loop uses the same single block, so all image boxes are 4/3 on every device; uniformity is preserved (it was uniformly 3/2 before)

alt_text.observed: the block renders the POST TITLE as alt, e.g. 'Aurelia Sde Dov - אורליה שדה דב', not the media library alt field
alt_text.verdict: descriptive and readable; unchanged by this edit

letterbox_background.verdict: bars fall on the site's warm cream paper, which is the same family as the plate paper; verifier condition 2 is satisfied without any CSS change

measured.after: 4/3 contain, 25.0% cream bars, no pixel lost

legacy_non_plate_results.assessment: no legacy content is lost, but 3:2 photos go from edge to edge to an 11.1% letterbox and 16:9 photos to a 25% letterbox. This is the known cost of the authorised setting and matches the verifier's condition 5 watch item.
